clauses.title: Ensured governance framework setting and maintenance
clauses.text: Analyze and articulate requirements for governance of enterprise IT, including AI, and put in place and maintain effective enabling structures, principles, processes and practices.

clauses.title: Ensured risk optimization
clauses.text: Ensure that enterprise risk appetite and tolerance are understood, articulated and communicated, and that the risk to enterprise value related to IT use is identified and managed.

clauses.title: Managed risk
clauses.text: Continually identify, assess and reduce IT-related risk within levels of tolerance set by enterprise executive management.

clauses.title: Managed security
clauses.text: Define, operate and monitor a system for information security management.

clauses.title: Managed business process controls
clauses.text: Define and maintain appropriate business process controls to ensure that information related to and processed by in-house or outsourced business processes satisfies information control requirements.
